title: Sigma-table aligned rho v15p: asserted 88-byte layout, executed-count pricing, repaired Montgomery kernels, exact label direction, passing invariant gate

claims.statement: Analytic secp256k1 ECDLP claim at success >= 0.39: six-class (negation and GLV) parallel rho walk priced from EXECUTED aarch64 instructions at the protected C=1000. The step is 1860.0 Ir: 744 point listing (head+tail per iteration) + 435 alignment (_v15o_align + 2 x _fmul) + 604 label (_v15o_label + 2 x _rmont) + 77 detector; the 125 Ir report routine is a SEPARATE row charged per delivered record and is not part of the step. Every counted symbol except the point-step loop is compiled fully unrolled, verified by scripts/check_executed.py to contain zero backward branches, so static length equals executed length; the point-step loop is counted over its head and tail blocks. One 88-byte record layout is defined once in scripts/rec_layout.h with _Static_assert on sizeof and every field offset, and scripts/check_layout.py proves the listing's stride and idx/len/esc offsets equal the compiler's. The label adds the selected jump's exponent pair, uses R mod r as Montgomery one, negates its unit multiplier unconditionally, and multiplies by (-1)^sgn * lambda^slot, the exact direction implied by align writing x' = beta^slot * x; the jump coefficients carry lambda^-slot separately. rmont is textbook CIOS with a 5-limb final subtraction and fmul folds limbwise from the top; both are exact on 20,000+ big-integer comparisons. The walk is a class function: idx depends only on the canonical key modulo the orbit-generated row family, measured at 0/2000 class mismatches between orbit partners with a 400/400 index-from-raw-x control. The ledger sums the rows as exact rationals, gives W_time = 2^127.73700286581716, and the claim is the smallest 1e-4 decimal covering W + 2e-5, proved in both directions. Success is 2643/6400 unconditional verified recoveries and 2612/6400 strictly inside S_ops at the q25 fixture (one-sided lowers 0.402798 and 0.397974), R = 2048, 16 trails, dp1, under the named random-map premise on the (r-1)/6 classes at pooled mu = 1.107, with success at rate p over w retained comparisons being 1-(1-p)^w. No production execution is claimed.
